summary: Fix duplicate console host-tunnel admission during HTTP and browser handshakes

guide.reason: Existing VM/host console instructions already require single-use tickets, a fresh ticket on each retry, and automatic reconnect without stopping running guests. No UI or operator steps changed.

api.reason: The existing agentConsole host-mTLS upgrade and shared VM/host browser-console streams promise one host tunnel per ticket. Admission now atomically consumes that right before upgrade, including the browser dequeue window. Payloads, authentication, statuses, expiry and Controller/Core compatibility are unchanged; reference descriptions are clarified.

roadmap.reason: A previously implemented console bug is corrected; no phase, feature or acceptance milestone changes status.

state.reason: The admission flag is process-local console-session exclusion. No new durable state, pool setting or identity is introduced; guest execution and durable VM records remain on Core. Controller replacement ends only the transient console connection.

verification.method: Forced real TCP handshake interleavings failed before the fix and passed ten race-detector repetitions after it, retaining actual WebSocket/RFB relay and refusal checks. Final runtime, suite and documentation evidence and simulation limits are recorded in the QA report; no remote CI or native console certification is claimed.
